still_novel_if: Source scouting happens before the main arbiter or full control bias exists.
The evidence includes mixed-polarity and strong impedance-asymmetry cases, not only equal-polarity multi-input startup.
Probe and handoff energy are fully counted and no helper rail appears.
weak_differentiation: If packet scouting reduces to ordinary priority OR-ing or threshold ranking, the overlap with the 2018 adaptive dual-source starter and 2017 multi-source PMU work becomes too strong.
If mixed-polarity or anti-backdrive stress is missing, the concept looks like another self-powered multi-input interface.
novelty_collapse_modes: Probe energy or mirror mismatch erases the startup-correctness gain.
Precharged probes, latches, or storage nodes create hidden-helper behavior.
Equal-overhead fixed-path or non-aware OR-ing baselines match startup success and handoff time.
Anti-backdrive benefit disappears under realistic leakage and ultra-slow-ramp cases.

still_novel_if: Mixed-polarity or reverse-suspect sources are central to the problem, not an artificial corner case.
Bucket separation prevents wrong-way startup current that the closest multi-input papers do not explicitly screen.
Merge overhead stays below the startup win under the weakest ramps.
weak_differentiation: If sources are rectified to one polarity before startup, the polarity-split story becomes unnecessary.
If one bucket effectively acts as a helper reservoir, the concept collapses toward assisted-startup prior art.
novelty_collapse_modes: Extra bucket capacitance, merge clamps, and latch overhead dominate the startup budget.
Leakage between buckets erases polarity safety.
A simple rectifier or ideal-diode baseline removes the mixed-polarity advantage.
Merge control chatters or leaves half-on isolation states.

still_novel_if: RC ranking costs materially less control energy than explicit comparators or active arbitration.
The ranker actually predicts the startup-successful source under ultra-slow ramps and high impedance asymmetry.
The framing stays on pre-arbitration startup correctness, not generic multi-source arbitration.
weak_differentiation: RC ranking is too close to ordinary arbitration unless the energy overhead is clearly lower.
Equal-polarity-only evidence would remove most of the H1 differentiation.
novelty_collapse_modes: Fast and slow RC signatures collapse together under ultra-slow ramps.
Switch, latch, and timing overhead approach a conventional comparator path.
Ranking errors do not improve startup success or handoff time.
The packet-scout root or even a fixed startup path matches the result under equal accounting.

still_novel_if: Leakage direction sensing works without comparator bias and without calibration-heavy tuning.
It materially improves startup correctness, not just reverse-current cosmetics.
It is treated as a sub-block inside a stronger H1 architecture.
weak_differentiation: Anti-backdrive alone is already expected in multi-input interfaces.
Using leakage as the sensor can look like a fragile implementation detail rather than a new architecture.
novelty_collapse_modes: Leakage signatures flip with process, temperature, or source amplitude.
The vote needs too many windows or too much calibration to matter at cold start.
Simple ideal-diode or latched OR-ing baselines match the benefit.
Wrong-way current suppression does not translate into better startup success or handoff.

still_novel_if: It is positioned strictly as a supporting block for the H1 handoff hazard.
The token chain adds negligible control energy and no hidden control rail.
It prevents a measured mixed-source failure that ordinary POR or hysteresis does not.
weak_differentiation: As a standalone angle it reads like a refined POR or UVLO deglitcher.
It is not inherently multi-source-specific unless tied to pre-arbitration handoff failure.
novelty_collapse_modes: The token chain behaves like another hidden bias or control rail.
Ordinary hysteresis or a conventional POR block achieves the same chatter suppression.
It reduces chatter but does not improve mixed-source startup correctness.
Its quiescent or pulse energy approaches the startup-control baselines.

still_novel_if: It is clearly the lowest-overhead implementation of packet scouting, not a separate broad claim.
Passive probing stays accurate enough under 1:5 and 1:20 impedance asymmetry.
It beats the RC ranker on startup benefit per control energy.
weak_differentiation: Without a clear overhead advantage, it is just another source-probing variant inside the packet-scout family.
Any need for explicit precharge, sense amplification, or hidden bias weakens the helper-free claim.
novelty_collapse_modes: Capacitor mismatch and injected charge loss corrupt the estimate.
The probe perturbs the weak source more than it informs the decision.
It fails to beat the RC ranker on startup benefit per control energy.
The full packet-scout root absorbs it as an implementation detail rather than a new angle.
